rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on overhang) with no third-party involvement qualifies as property damage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; approximately four shingles blown off. Estimated repair cost $400 with no water intrusion or structural damage. Low-severity property damage claim requiring roofer assessment.

case_facts.description: wind blew off approximately four shingles from overhang above back porch
